newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group offered shares in BLeisure.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group offered shares in BLeisure.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group said on Wednesday it has received an offer to acquire 75.32 million new shares in Berjaya Leisure Bhd from Berjaya Industrial Bhd for 210.91 million ringgit in cash.

Berjaya Industrial had earlier proposed a rationalisation exercise which involve the divestment of its property-based companies to Berjaya Leisure for 210.91 million ringgit to be satisfied by an issue of 75.32 million new Berjaya Leisure shares at 2.80 ringgit per share.
The new shares will be offered to Berjaya Group at the same unit price issued by Berjaya Leisure, Berjaya Group said in a statement.
Currently, Berjaya Group has a pending proposal to acquire 50.48 percent equity interest in Berjaya Leisure from Berjaya Industrial.
